value.rationale: Repeated pyramiding over a convex polygon is a basic infinite family of convex polytopes. The result gives the exact minimum count of pyramiding operations necessary to repair the original apex resistance-curvature negativity under the canonical fixed unit-edge conductances. It simultaneously shows rim curvature stays positive and there are no zero-curvature integer transition cases. The quadratic phase is structural and follows from exact first two spectral moments, not arbitrary finite parameter enumeration; it does not follow merely from the generic resistance formula.
